why: An own-boards game shown as seats: each friend has a card, and their board, the thing they are playing, is on nobody's screen but their own (the Brickbloom pilot of 2026-10-06 showed each friend's board live beside yours; the creator, 2026-10-14: "You can fix seeing your friend default"). Gate E must fail it: each player plays a board of their own, so each screen must show the other's board, live.
